output.objection: You are missing the point. I need formal security sign off on the observability pipeline because loyalty basket data flows through those logs.
output.correction: I am not asking for the data to be deleted or the pipeline to be slower. I am asking for a strict review gate to ensure we comply with consent and retention rules before any log is written.
